summary: Solo winter climber Ryan Montoya fell an estimated 1,000-2,000 feet from just below the Pyramid Peak summit after his foot punched through a cornice; he survived with a pelvis broken in three places and frostbitten fingers, dug snow caves during two unplanned nights out, and reached rescuers on the third day via the East Maroon Portal.
location: Pyramid Peak, near summit / East Maroon Portal
notes: Identified via the 2023-12-30 Colorado 14ers group thread; OP misremembered the peak as Capitol Peak and commenters corrected it to Pyramid Peak and named Montoya; solo winter attempt. | 2026-09-15: 14ers.com link removed per site ban; row retains other verified source(s).
